sn35.64:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Migajālo yena Bhagavā tenupasaṅkami || pe || || 3
sn35.64:1.2: Ekam antaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Migajālo Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn35.64:1.3: Sādhu me bhante Bhagavā saṃkhittena dhammaṃ desetu || yam aham dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti || || 4-6
sn35.64:2.1: Santi kho Migajāla cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn35.64:2.2: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.64:2.3: tassa tam abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi ||
sn35.64:2.5: Santi kho Migajāla jivhāviññeyyā rasā || la || || 9
sn35.64:2.6: Santi kho Migajāla manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn35.64:2.7: Tañce bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati ||
sn35.64:2.8: tassa tam abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandi ||
sn35.64:3.1: Santi kho Migajāla cakkhuviññeyyā rūpā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn35.64:3.2: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati || tassa tam anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandi nirujjhati ||
sn35.64:3.4: Santi kho Migajāla jivhāviññeyyā rasā iṭṭhā kantā || pe || 15
sn35.64:3.5: Santi kho Migajāla manoviññeyyā dhammā iṭṭhā kantā manāpā piyarūpā kāmupasaṃhitā rajanīyā || ||
sn35.64:3.6: Tañce bhikkhu nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati || tassa taṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato nandi nirujjhati ||
sn35.64:4.1: Atha kho āyasmā Migajālo Bhagavato bhāsitam abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi || || 17
sn35.64:4.2: Atha kho āyasmā Migajālo eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyam pabbajanti || tad anuttaram brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayam abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihāsi || ||
sn35.64:4.3: Khīṇā jāti vusitam brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīya nāparam itthattāyāti abbhaññasi || || 18
sn35.64:4.4: Aññataro va panāyasmā Migajālo arahataṃ ahosīti || 1
